signal: BoomPop raised a $41M round in November 2025 led by Wing VC and added a VP of partnerships and a VP/GM for its events agency to scale its AI events platform.

email.body1:
Madelyn, saw BoomPop just closed $41M and brought on a VP of partnerships and a GM for BoomPop Studio.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the sales team can cover before the new leaders ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for BoomPop off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Madelyn, quick follow-up for BoomPop.

Post-raise, the pipeline number tends to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BoomPop needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Madelyn, last bit of proof for BoomPop.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BoomPop's reply rate likely compares to other recently funded startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Madelyn, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to BoomPop's motion? I'll tailor it to your team either way.
